description: This file defines types and an interface for storing and managing conversations in MS Teams proactive messaging. It includes data structures for conversation references and a store interface with methods to upsert, get, list, remove, and search conversations.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Method to insert or update a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Method to retrieve a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Method to list all conversation store entries.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Method to remove a conversation entry by conversation ID.

methods.name: findPreferredDmByUserId
methods.description: Method to find the most recent personal DM conversation for a user ID.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Deprecated method to find a conversation by user ID; use `findPreferredDmByUserId` instead.
